children: On October 21, 2026, Nasdaq notified NEXTNRG that its market value of listed securities had fallen below the $35 million minimum under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(2), and that the company also failed to meet the alternative equity and net income standards. NEXTNRG has until April 19, 2027, to regain compliance; its appeal of a separate Nasdaq delisting determination over the minimum bid-price requirement is pending, and the hearing panel may consider this additional deficiency.
